summary: Henan province: 18 cities and 8 sights and gateways on the 米-shaped rail hub at Zhengzhou, with Yellow River bridges and mountain tunnels as the special routes.
designGoals: Keep the 米-shaped high-speed hub at Zhengzhou as the skeleton, with an outer ring of conventional lines so that going around Zhengzhou is a real choice.
Make the Yellow River the theme: every route between the north bank and the rest of the province is a Yellow River Bridge and needs a locomotive.
Put mountain tunnels where the Taihang, Xiao, Funiu, Song and Dabie ranges are.
Place stations in their real relative positions and name them in Chinese.
Reuse the standard rules unchanged; only the number of trains per player is set for this map.
changeSummary: First version: 26 stations, 45 routes (5 Yellow River bridges, 9 mountain tunnels, 5 double routes), 6 long and 44 regular tickets, 30 trains per player.
map.json and tickets.json are written by scripts/config/henan-map-source.mjs; a ticket is worth the fewest spaces between its two stations.
The basemap is drawn by scripts/config/henan-basemap.mjs.
playtestFocus: Whether Zhengzhou is still too strong a hub with four players.
Whether the scenic spurs (Red Flag Canal, Jigong Mountain, Shaolin Temple, Laojun Mountain) are worth the trip.
Whether five Yellow River bridges are enough for four players heading north.
Which stations and routes can be removed; notes.md marks the candidates.
